# Sprint 3 model cards (generated by `python -m src.league_models.stat_benchmark`)

All candidates: score-only (openfootball scores, licence-clean), fitted per outer fold on matches available at the fold cutoff, parameters frozen for the eval season, `BACKTEST_LIMITED`, DEV-only evidence. None is in production.

## A_dc
Global ridge Poisson / Dixon-Coles. Reference of Sprint 3.

- Parameters: L2 team 2.0, rho on 0-0/0-1/1-0/1-1, grid 0..12.
- Per-fold status: 2020-21: TRAINED; 2021-22: TRAINED; 2022-23: TRAINED; 2023-24: TRAINED; 2024-25: TRAINED
- Known limits: score-only features; UEFA finals are scored with a home advantage; clubs unseen in training get league-average strength and are counted.

## A_dc_norho / A_dc_rest / A_dc_shrink
Ablations of A_dc: no rho; rest-days covariate; team ridge x4.0

- Parameters: Hypothesis tests only.
- Per-fold status: 2020-21: TRAINED; 2021-22: TRAINED; 2022-23: TRAINED; 2023-24: TRAINED; 2024-25: TRAINED
- Known limits: score-only features; UEFA finals are scored with a home advantage; clubs unseen in training get league-average strength and are counted.

## B_dc_league
A_dc + competition intercept and home advantage + country levels (the cross-league bridge).

- Parameters: L2 country 1.0, competition 1.0, home deviation 2.0; country levels only when the fold has >= 200 international training matches.
- Per-fold status: 2020-21: TRAINED; 2021-22: TRAINED; 2022-23: TRAINED; 2023-24: TRAINED; 2024-25: TRAINED
- Known limits: score-only features; UEFA finals are scored with a home advantage; clubs unseen in training get league-average strength and are counted.

## B_dc_league_nohome
B_dc_league without the competition home-advantage deviation.

- Parameters: Hypothesis test only.
- Per-fold status: 2020-21: TRAINED; 2021-22: TRAINED; 2022-23: TRAINED; 2023-24: TRAINED; 2024-25: TRAINED
- Known limits: score-only features; UEFA finals are scored with a home advantage; clubs unseen in training get league-average strength and are counted.

## C_dc_local
One DC per competition on its own training matches.

- Parameters: NOT_TRAINED below 100 local matches (explicit fallback to B_dc_league). Production-ineligible below 500.
- Per-fold status: 2020-21: see diagnostics; 2021-22: see diagnostics; 2022-23: see diagnostics; 2023-24: see diagnostics; 2024-25: see diagnostics
- Known limits: score-only features; UEFA finals are scored with a home advantage; clubs unseen in training get league-average strength and are counted.

## D_blend
(1 - w) * B_dc_league + w * C_dc_local, matrix level.

- Parameters: w per competition on the inner-validation season, grid step 0.05, shrunk by n/(n+300); 0 below 60 validation matches.
- Per-fold status: 2020-21: see diagnostics; 2021-22: see diagnostics; 2022-23: see diagnostics; 2023-24: see diagnostics; 2024-25: see diagnostics
- Known limits: score-only features; UEFA finals are scored with a home advantage; clubs unseen in training get league-average strength and are counted.

## E_elo_bridge
Per-country time-aware Elo with UEFA-learned country offsets.

- Parameters: K 20.0, home advantage 60.0, goal-difference multiplier, season reversion 0.25 to the country mean, promoted prior -50.0, bridge K 6.0.
- Per-fold status: 2020-21: TRAINED; 2021-22: TRAINED; 2022-23: TRAINED; 2023-24: TRAINED; 2024-25: TRAINED
- Known limits: score-only features; UEFA finals are scored with a home advantage; clubs unseen in training get league-average strength and are counted.

## F_elo_local
One Elo per competition on its own history.

- Parameters: No country offsets; explicit fallback to E_elo_bridge when NOT_TRAINED.
- Per-fold status: 2020-21: see diagnostics; 2021-22: see diagnostics; 2022-23: see diagnostics; 2023-24: see diagnostics; 2024-25: see diagnostics
- Known limits: score-only features; UEFA finals are scored with a home advantage; clubs unseen in training get league-average strength and are counted.
